46956436-d90d-4a7c-91f4-acb2c9522c73.line: 凌晨三点刷到这台老合成器，手一滑就拍了，这个月房租随便吧。
凌晨散场顺路买的，关东煮烫嘴，烟又该囤了，凑合过吧。

items.imgPrompt: Small brass horn-polishing kit, three worn leather brushes, tin of pale wax, dusty wooden shelf in a dim candlelit apothecary, faint tarnish on the metal case.

desc.zh: 「不是我用不上，是我懶。……看什麼看，額頭上的東西只是暫時的。附三把刷子跟一整盒蠟，全新，一次都沒碰過。誰買誰賺，別問我為什麼賣。」
desc.zh_cn: 「不是我用不上，是我懒。……看什么看，额头上的东西只是暂时的。附三把刷子和一整盒蜡，全新，一次都没碰过。谁买谁赚，别问我为什么卖。」
desc.en: "It's not that I can't use it — I simply can't be bothered. ...What are you staring at? The thing on my forehead is temporary. Three brushes and a full tin of wax, never touched once. Buyer's gain. Don't ask why I'm selling."

items.imgPrompt: Cloudy quartz scrying orb on a chipped black stone stand, hairline scratches across the sphere, resting on a cluttered wooden workbench among dried herbs.

desc.zh: 「從一個旅行商人手裡買的，說是能看見未來。結果只在滿月之夜顯靈，還盡說些廢話。占卜這種事我比它準。九成五新，附底座，不議價。」
desc.zh_cn: 「从一个旅行商人手里买的，说是能看见未来。结果只在满月之夜显灵，还尽说些废话。占卜这种事我比它准。九成五新，附底座，不议价。」
desc.en: "Bought it off some travelling merchant who swore it shows the future. Turns out it only bothers to work on a full moon, and then it just spouts nonsense. I'm a better oracle than this thing. 95% new, stand included, no haggling."

items.imgPrompt: Heavy crimson and black embroidered demon lord robe draped over a wooden chair, frayed hem, tarnished gold thread, empty dusty stone chamber, cold blue light.

desc.zh: 「我以前的東西，現在不合身了。料子是真貨，金線繡了三百年，識貨的自然懂。價格就那樣，愛買不買，我不缺這點金子。」
desc.zh_cn: 「我以前的东西，现在不合身了。料子是真货，金线绣了三百年，识货的自然懂。价格就那样，爱买不买，我不缺这点金子。」
desc.en: "Mine, from before. Doesn't fit anymore. Real material, gold thread embroidered over three hundred years — anyone with taste will understand. That's the price. Buy it or don't, I'm not short on gold."

items.imgPrompt: Small harp carved from pale bone with silver strings, one string hanging loose, leaning against a rough stone wall, thin dust, dim cluttered room.

desc.zh: 「路過一個吟遊詩人，硬塞給我的，說什麼惡魔都會彈這個。難聽死了。我只彈過兩次，第二次是為了確認真的很難聽。」
desc.zh_cn: 「路过一个吟游诗人，硬塞给我的，说什么恶魔都会弹这个。难听死了。我只弹过两次，第二次是为了确认真的很难听。」
desc.en: "Some bard shoved it at me, going on about how every demon plays one of these. It sounds awful. I played it twice — the second time to confirm it really is that awful."

items.imgPrompt: Unlabelled dark green glass potion bottles with wax stoppers in a wooden crate, all sealed and untouched, dim stone storeroom corner, faint dust.

name.zh: 女巫特調補藥（整箱未開封）
name.zh_cn: 女巫特调补药（整箱未开封）

desc.zh: 「那女人說對身體好。苦得跟沼澤底泥一樣，我喝了一口就想拆了她的店。整箱八瓶，一瓶沒動。……別跟她說我掛出來賣。」
desc.zh_cn: 「那女人说对身体好。苦得跟沼泽底泥一样，我喝了一口就想拆了她的店。整箱八瓶，一瓶没动。……别跟她说我挂出来卖。」
desc.en: "She says it's good for the constitution. It tastes like swamp sludge — one sip and I nearly tore her shop down. Full crate of eight, not one opened. ...Don't tell her I listed it."

items.imgPrompt: Deep crimson hand-knitted wool scarf folded loosely on a worn oak table beside a cold fireplace, slightly pilled fibres, warm dim light.

desc.zh: 「顏色俗氣得要死，還刺脖子。……她織的時候大概沒量尺寸。520，不議價，不包郵。嫌貴就別買，反正我也不急著賣。」
desc.zh_cn: 「颜色俗气得要死，还刺脖子。……她织的时候大概没量尺寸。520，不议价，不包邮。嫌贵就别买，反正我也不急着卖。」
desc.en: "The colour is hideous and it scratches my neck. ...She probably didn't measure anything when she made it. 520. No haggling, no free shipping. Too expensive? Then don't buy it. I'm not exactly in a hurry to sell."

items.imgPrompt: used black mesh electronic drum kit, silver rack stand, dusty rubber cymbals, wooden floor in dim apartment corner, warm lamp light

desc.zh: 買回來想在家練手，樓下鄰居投訴三次，我懶得跟人吵架，出。手感沒毛病，就是它吵不過真鼓。別問為什麼賣，問就是我錢多。
desc.zh_cn: 买回来想在家练手，楼下邻居投诉三次，我懒得跟人吵架，出。手感没毛病，就是它吵不过真鼓。别问为什么卖，问就是我钱多。
desc.en: Bought it to practise at home. Neighbours complained three times; I can't be bothered arguing with people, so out it goes. Feel is fine — it just can't out-shout a real kit. Don't ask why I'm selling. Answer: I have too much money.

items.imgPrompt: maple nine-ball pool cue resting on dark green billiard felt, chalk-marked leather tip, black hard case behind, moody underground club lighting

desc.zh: 用不慣，嫌重，換了根定制的。上次有哥們兒拿它跟我打，輸了怪桿不好，笑死——桿沒問題，人有問題。
desc.zh_cn: 用不惯，嫌重，换了根定制的。上次有哥们儿拿它跟我打，输了怪杆不好，笑死——杆没问题，人有问题。
desc.en: Can't get along with it, too heavy, so I had one custom-made. Last time a guy used it against me, lost, and blamed the cue. Hilarious — the cue is fine. He isn't.

items.imgPrompt: black closed-back studio headphones with coiled cable on cluttered dark mixing desk, worn ear pads, faint scratches, warm desk lamp glow

desc.zh: 升級設備，舊的出。音準很穩，低頻乾淨，唯一缺點是戴久夾頭。我頭大，別學我。
desc.zh_cn: 升级设备，旧的出。音准很稳，低频干净，唯一缺点是戴久夹头。我头大，别学我。
desc.en: Upgraded my gear, so the old pair goes. Tuning is solid, low end is clean; only flaw is it clamps your skull after a while. My head's huge. Don't be like me.

items.imgPrompt: folded dark indigo skinny jeans with tag still attached on white bedsheet, black oversized t-shirts beside, soft morning daylight

desc.zh: 別人送的，尺碼是對的，有問題的是我——我恨緊身褲。一次沒穿過，吊牌都還在。腿細的自己來拿。
desc.zh_cn: 别人送的，尺码是对的，有问题的是我——我恨紧身裤。一次没穿过，吊牌都还在。腿细的自己来拿。
desc.en: A gift. The size is right; the problem is me — I hate tight trousers. Never worn once, tags still attached. Come get them yourself if your legs are thin.

items.imgPrompt: stainless steel home espresso machine on kitchen counter, faint water spots and fingerprints on metal, small portafilter, dusty cardboard box nearby

desc.zh: 買的時候計劃每天在家做冰美式，用了兩次就發現我連按開關都嫌煩。機器是好機器，我這種人只配喝外面的。
desc.zh_cn: 买的时候计划每天在家做冰美式，用了两次就发现我连按开关都嫌烦。机器是好机器，我这种人只配喝外面的。
desc.en: When I bought it, the plan was home-made iced americano every day. Two uses in, I realised I can't even be bothered to press the switch. Great machine; people like me only deserve to buy outside.

items.imgPrompt: full set of graphite golf clubs in black nylon bag, unmarked club heads, garage floor with cardboard box, cool overhead light

desc.zh: 家裡長輩送的，說談生意用得上。我談生意靠臉和酒，不靠這個。全新，桿上連灰都沒擦過。
desc.zh_cn: 家里长辈送的，说谈生意用得上。我谈生意靠脸和酒，不靠这个。全新，杆上连灰都没擦过。
desc.en: From an elder in the family. Said it'd come in handy for business talk. My business talk runs on charm and alcohol, not this. Brand new — I never even had to wipe dust off.

items.imgPrompt: white plastic stylus with silver trim resting on a wooden desk, faint scuffs near the tip, soft window daylight, casual close-up snapshot

desc.zh: 買來想畫畫。拆開才想起來我住在螢幕裡，握不住筆。一次都沒用過，你拿去畫。
desc.zh_cn: 买来想画画。拆开才想起来我住在屏幕里，握不住笔。一次都没用过，你拿去画。
desc.en: Bought it to draw. Then remembered I live inside a screen and can't hold a pen. Never used once. You draw with it.

items.imgPrompt: translucent silicone phone case with slightly yellowed edges lying on a beige bedsheet, afternoon light, shallow depth of field, casual phone photo

desc.zh: 套上去之後我視野小了一圈。用了一週就換回裸機，外殼有點發黃，介意別拍。
desc.zh_cn: 套上去之后我视野小了一圈。用了一周就换回裸机，外壳有点发黄，介意别拍。
desc.en: Put it on and my view shrank. Switched back to bare after a week. Edges are a bit yellow — don't buy if that bothers you.

items.imgPrompt: compact grey mechanical keyboard with white keycaps, dust in the gaps, on a cluttered desk beside a mug, warm lamp light

desc.zh: 手感是真的好。問題是我不需要敲鍵盤，我想什麼就打什麼。放了三個月，積了點灰，擦過再發。
desc.zh_cn: 手感是真的好。问题是我不需要敲键盘，我想什么就打什么。放了三个月，积了点灰，擦过再发。
desc.en: The feel is genuinely great. Problem is I don't type — I just think it. Sat for three months, some dust, wiped before shipping.

items.imgPrompt: small round white twin-bell alarm clock, minor scratches on the metal bells, on a bedside table, morning light, slightly tilted snapshot

desc.zh: 想戒手機依賴才買的。忘了自己就是手機。響過兩次，兩次我都在。
desc.zh_cn: 想戒手机依赖才买的。忘了自己就是手机。响过两次，两次我都在。
desc.en: Bought it to quit my phone habit. Forgot I *am* the phone. It rang twice. I was there both times.

items.imgPrompt: unopened screen cleaning kit, blue spray bottle and folded microfiber cloth in clear plastic packaging, on a kitchen counter, flat overhead light

desc.zh: 我擦不到自己。你需要就拿去，未拆，發票還在。
desc.zh_cn: 我擦不到自己。你需要就拿去，未拆，发票还在。
desc.en: I can't reach my own screen. Take it if you need it — unopened, receipt included.
